$comment: Template for the Google Play (phone/tablet) Bubblewrap project.
`npm run pack:phone -- --domain <host>` renders this into twa-manifest.json (gitignored),
because a TWA is bound to one origin and that origin differs per environment.
This is the same web build as the Quest package — one codebase, one deployment — with four
isMetaQuest: false        - a Play build, not a Horizon build.
no horizonOSAppMode       - there is no immersive session to launch straight into; the
player starts on the menu and the game runs on the screen.
orientation: landscape    - the touch layout puts a stick under the left thumb and the
action cluster under the right. Portrait would need a second
layout, and a chase game read through a letterbox is worse.
packageId                 - MUST differ from the Quest package if both are ever published
to stores that share an id namespace. They do not today (Play
and Horizon are separate), so the same derivation is used and
display: fullscreen       - a game with its own HUD must not present browser chrome.
signingKey                - Play binds the listing to this key forever. Losing it means
never shipping an update to this listing again.
name: Kangaroo Chase
